candidate.definition_en: A network of fine threads made by a spider; the Internet.
candidate.explanation_ar: شبكة خيوط بيعملها العنكبوت، أو شبكة الإنترنت اللي بتربط العالم ببعضه.

senses.definition_en: A network of fine threads spun by a spider to catch insects.
senses.definition_ar: شبكة العنكبوت التي ينسجها لصيد الحشرات.

senses.definition_en: The World Wide Web; the internet system for accessing websites and documents.

examples: Flies get caught in the spider's web.
You can find a lot of useful information on the web.
